name: @va-team/nabu-1password
description: Per-user 1Password read access. Brokers a per-user 1Password service-account token from the Nabu backend per invocation and runs the native op CLI in a scoped child process. Exposes a single read-only passthrough tool the agent uses to resolve secret references and list items/vaults.

apiToken.description: Per-organization skill bearer issued by the OnePassword module on the Nabu backend (sent as x-skill-token; requests also carry env-derived x-organization-id). Accepts either a literal string or a SecretRef object {source, provider, id} resolved from env.

apiBaseUrl.description: NestJS backend base URL — Docker-internal (default http://app:6001).
